headline: Recall plugin gives Claude Code offline memory, saving tokens and boosting privacy
summary: Recall eliminates cold starts for Claude Code users by persistently and privately saving session context locally. It ensures projects pick up exactly where they left off without external calls or token waste.
details: Claude Code users often face repetition, restating goals and context with each new session. The free Recall plugin for Claude Code solves this by providing durable, offline memory. It eliminates friction, saving tokens and patience.
Recall works by keeping a local, append-only log of all sessions, capturing prompts, replies, files, and commands to disk. This data never leaves your machine, ensuring privacy.

Instead of re-explaining, Recall generates a concise summary from this local log using a classical Python summarizer. This summary is then injected into the next session, allowing the AI assistant to understand the project state without burning tokens on context.

This local-first approach means no dependency on external APIs, keys, or cloud services. Unlike many "AI memory" tools, Recall never uploads session logs or uses cloud summarization, keeping your code and secrets on your machine.

Token waste is significantly reduced as local summarization costs zero model tokens. The classical Python algorithm runs on your local CPU, avoiding Claude API calls and token costs for summary creation.

Resuming from a compact summary (typically 1,000–2,000 tokens) is far more efficient than re-feeding extensive project context. This dramatically shrinks overall token usage, making Claude Code subscriptions go further.
For users on metered Claude Code subscriptions, Recall translates to real savings. It allows for several times the mileage out of each credit by shifting memory and recap work fully offline.

Setup is straightforward: clone the GitHub repo, place plugin files in Claude Code's local plugin directory, and launch your session. Recall works automatically in the background without manual saving or configuration.

headline_marked: [[Vercel open-sources Eve]], a framework for durable AI agents with a filesystem-first approach
headline: Vercel open-sources Eve, a framework for durable AI agents with a filesystem-first approach
summary: Eve simplifies building AI agents by handling model loops, tool dispatch, and session persistence. It allows agents to serve multiple platforms simultaneously without changing core logic.
details: Vercel recently open-sourced Eve, a framework designed for building durable AI agents. It adopts an opinionated, filesystem-first approach, abstracting away the complexities of wiring up model loops, tool dispatch, and session persistence.

Eve draws a clear distinction between the agent's reasoning core and its communication channels. This design allows the same agent to simultaneously serve various platforms like browser chat widgets, Slack bots, or custom webhooks, without requiring conditional logic within the agent itself.

Channels in Eve act as edge adapters, normalizing inbound messages, managing conversation resume handles, and determining how responses are delivered. Eve ships with integrations for popular platforms including Slack, Discord, Teams, and Telegram, and also supports custom channel development.

The default `eve.ts` channel provides a session-based HTTP API, enabling durable sessions that survive server restarts and support reconnection at any event index. This fundamentally differs from stateless request/response models by maintaining conversation state server-side.

Eve's durability is powered by a workflow engine, built on the open-source Workflow SDK, which checkpoints progress at each step boundary. If a process crashes mid-turn, it resumes from the last completed step, preventing the need to replay entire interactions.

For production environments, Eve's durability is pluggable via the Workflow SDK's "World" abstraction. This allows developers to choose different storage, queue, and streaming backends for scalable session persistence, or even build custom solutions.
caption:
